title: Unwind the stack
hints: During a panic, each function's deferred calls run (last deferred first) before the panic moves on to the caller. `recover` in the outermost deferred function stops it after everything else has run.

For `Unwind`, write a recursive helper `level(w io.Writer, i, depth int)` that prints `enter`, does `defer fmt.Fprintln(w, "exit", i)`, then panics or recurses. `Unwind` itself defers the recovering closure **before** calling `level(w, 1, depth)`.

In `Acquire`, the **first** statement is `defer func() { if r := recover(); r != nil { fmt.Fprintln(w, "error:", r) } }()` (deferred first ⇒ runs last). Then loop: `fmt.Fprintln(w, "acquire", name)`, `defer fmt.Fprintln(w, "release", name)`, `if i == failAt { panic("failed at " + name) }`; after the loop print `all done`.
